summary: Tesla runs its own careers system on tesla.com behind Akamai bot protection, which returns 403 Access Denied to automated clients, so no supported method can read it without getting around bot protection.
how_it_works: The careers search page (https://www.tesla.com/careers/search/?query=intern) loads its listings from Tesla's internal endpoint https://www.tesla.com/cua-api/apps/careers/state, which returns JSON holding all listings and lookup tables for location and department. A browser would fetch it and filter listings by title keyword. Akamai blocks that endpoint and the page for automated clients, so it is only reachable from a real, unflagged browser session. Tesla doesn't use Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever, Workday or another third-party job board.
evidence: Automatic inspection with headless Chromium got HTTP 403 with page title 'Access Denied' and no API requests or job links. WebFetch of https://www.tesla.com/cua-api/apps/careers/state also returned 403. Greenhouse board 'tesla' reset the connection, and Ashby and Lever 'tesla' returned 404. Bash wasn't available in this session, so I couldn't try curl or scripts/test_method.py.

summary: Fortinet uses Oracle Recruiting Cloud (HCM Candidate Experience), which has a public JSON search API with a total count, but no supported method handles it; the browser methods can't work because the page loads results 25 at a time through a 'Show more results' button rather than URL pages.
how_it_works: GET https://edel.fa.us2.oraclecloud.com/hcmRestApi/resources/latest/recruitingCEJobRequisitions?onlyData=true&expand=requisitionList.secondaryLocations&finder=findReqs;siteNumber=CX_2001,limit=25,offset=N,locationId=300000000361286,sortBy=POSTING_DATES_DESC and page with offset until items[0].requisitionList is empty or offset >= items[0].TotalJobsCount. Each job has Id, Title, PrimaryLocation, PostedDate; the job URL is https://edel.fa.us2.oraclecloud.com/hcmUI/CandidateExperience/en/sites/CX_2001/job/{Id}. Params: host, site_number, optional keyword and location_id.
evidence: The careers page calls hcmRestApi/CandidateExperience endpoints on edel.fa.us2.oraclecloud.com. Calling the requisitions finder with curl, without logging in, returned TotalJobsCount 545 for keyword=intern, and the LOCATIONS facet lists Canada (Id 300000000361286) with 144 jobs. The browser methods don't click 'Show more results', so they would only ever get the first 25.

summary: onsemi uses Oracle Recruiting Cloud (Candidate Experience site CX_1001), which has a public JSON search API with a total, but no supported method covers it, and the browser methods are unreliable because the Oracle page renders its job list and '7 OPEN JOBS' total 3-5 seconds after the network goes idle.
how_it_works: GET https://{host}/hcmRestApi/resources/latest/recruitingCEJobRequisitions?onlyData=true&expand=requisitionList&finder=findReqs;siteNumber={site},selectedLocationsFacet={location_id},limit=25,offset={n} (URL-encode the finder value). items[0].TotalJobsCount is the total; items[0].requisitionList[] has Id, Title, PrimaryLocation, PostedDate. Page by offset += 25 until offset >= TotalJobsCount. Job URL: https://{host}/hcmUI/CandidateExperience/en/sites/{site}/job/{Id}. Params for onsemi: host=hctz.fa.us2.oraclecloud.com, site=CX_1001, selectedLocationsFacet=300000000341944 (Canada). A small fixed wait (~6s) or wait_for_selector on job links in the browser methods would also fix the browser approach.
evidence: curl of the API with selectedLocationsFacet=300000000341944 returned HTTP 200 JSON with TotalJobsCount 7 (e.g. Id 2506170 'Digital IC Designer'). Rendering the Canada page with the project's own load() showed body text of 753/1014 chars with 0 job links at ~0.6s and ~2.7s, and 7 job links plus '7 OPEN JOBS' only at ~4.8s. browser_paginated with total_regex therefore failed ('total_regex didn't match the first page'), and re-testing browser_page in attempt 3 failed: scrape 1 returned 0 jobs while scrape 2 returned 7.

summary: Sinclair Technologies posts jobs on ADP Workforce Now (cid 5b36c411-2caf-42bb-add4-63afc8e7706c, ccId 9200693907439_2), which no supported method handles; browser_page on the ADP page read 0 jobs because listings are not anchor links.
how_it_works: GET https://workforcenow.adp.com/mascsr/default/careercenter/public/events/staffing/v1/job-requisitions?cid=CID&ccId=CCID&lang=en_CA&locale=en_CA&$top=50 (page with $skip). The response has meta.totalNumber and jobRequisitions[] with requisitionTitle, itemID, postDate and requisitionLocations[].nameCode.shortName. Job URL: https://workforcenow.adp.com/mascsr/default/mdf/recruitment/recruitment.html?cid=CID&ccId=CCID&lang=en_CA&jobId=EXTERNAL_JOB_ID (ExternalJobID from customFieldGroup.stringFields) or itemID. evidence: norsat.com/pages/careers links the Sinclair section to the ADP URL with ccId=9200693907439_2 (the other ccId 9200686826445_2 is Norsat). curl of the public API with no login returned totalNumber 7: Fabricator, Manufacturing Engineer, Production Staff, Planner Junior, Financial Accountant, Accounts Receivable Specialist, Logistics Specialist Junior, all in Aurora, ON, CA. browser_page on the ADP recruitment page found 0 jobs.

summary: Tesla runs its own in-house applicant tracking system behind bot protection, which returns 403 Access Denied to automated clients. None of the supported methods can reach it without bypassing that protection.
how_it_works: Tesla's careers page (tesla.com/careers/search) loads listings from Tesla's own internal API under tesla.com/cua-api. That API is not Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, or Workday. Both the page and the API return 403 to non-browser requests. Check Tesla internships in Canada by hand, or use an aggregator that is allowed to republish Tesla listings.
evidence: Automatic inspection got HTTP 403 with the page title 'Access Denied' and no links or API requests. curl with a browser User-Agent got 403 for both /careers/search/?query=intern and /cua-api/apps/careers/state. The Greenhouse, Ashby, and Lever boards named 'tesla' all return 404. Reporting says Tesla built its own HR and applicant tracking software (driveteslacanada.ca/?p=55675), and Tesla has posted jobs for engineers to build its in-house applicant tracking system.

summary: NovAtel jobs are on a classic iCIMS portal (careers-hexagonpositioning.icims.com) behind AWS WAF; Chromium gets a 'confirm you are human' challenge (HTTP 405), so browser methods fail, and there is no Greenhouse/Ashby/Lever/Workday board.
how_it_works: GET https://careers-hexagonpositioning.icims.com/jobs/search?ss=1&in_iframe=1&pr=N with a plain HTTP client, starting at pr=0, and collect links matching /jobs/\d+/[^/]+/job. Stop at the last page from the 'Page X of Y' text, which gives a page total for completeness.
evidence: curl to /jobs/search?ss=1&in_iframe=1 returned HTTP 200 with 20 job links and 'Page 1 of 2'; pr=1 returned 17 more links and 'Page 2 of 2'. browser_paginated on the same URL failed in the validator with 'page returned HTTP 405' (AWS WAF challenge, as shown in evidence.json).

summary: MDA Space uses UKG Pro (UltiPro) Recruiting, which no supported method handles. The browser methods can't read titles because each job link is an <a> inside a web component's shadow DOM whose text comes through a <slot>, so innerText is empty.
how_it_works: POST JSON to https://recruiting.ultipro.ca/{TENANT}/JobBoard/{BOARD_ID}/JobBoardView/LoadSearchResults with body {"opportunitySearch":{"Top":50,"Skip":N,"QueryString":"","OrderBy":[],"Filters":[]},"matchCriteria":{"PreferredJobs":[],"Educations":[],"LicenseAndCertifications":[],"Skills":[],"hasNoLicenses":false,"SkippedSkills":[]}}, paging Skip by 50 until totalCount is reached. Each opportunity has Id, Title and Locations[].Address (City, State.Name, Country.Name); the job URL is https://recruiting.ultipro.ca/{TENANT}/JobBoard/{BOARD_ID}/OpportunityDetail?opportunityId={Id}. Params: host (recruiting.ultipro.ca or recruiting.ultipro.com), tenant (MAC5000MCDW), board_id (7667adcc-47ae-477a-9183-0d8ef8bc0748).
evidence: A plain curl POST without cookies or tokens returned JSON with totalCount 25 and 25 opportunities with titles such as 'Student - Corporate Business Transformation' and 'Engineering Student - FPGA Verification - Winter 2027', and locations like Brampton, Ontario, Canada. The page itself says 'Showing 25 of 25 opportunities', but in Chromium every OpportunityDetail link renders as with empty innerText, which is why browser_page failed with 25 of 25 untitled jobs.

summary: The careers page is a SmartRecruiters career site whose job list only expands through a JavaScript Show more jobs button, so no supported method gets every job; SmartRecruiters is not in methods.json.
how_it_works: GET https://api.smartrecruiters.com/v1/companies/GDMSI/postings?limit=100&offset=N (optionally &country=ca). The response has totalFound and content[] with id, name, location {city, country}; job URL is https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/GDMSI/{id}. Page with offset until offset >= totalFound. Param: company identifier (GDMSI).
evidence: The public API returned totalFound=98 (65 with country ca: Ottawa 45, Calgary 14, Cole Harbour 3, Dartmouth 2, Sherbrooke 1). Tested browser_paginated on career-page-ca with page=N: 24 jobs (page param ignored). browser_page on careers.smartrecruiters.com/GDMSI: 41 jobs (grouped by location, truncated per group). Adding location=Ottawa%2C%20CA to the URL returned 0 jobs.

summary: GDLS Canada's only job board is a Jobvite TalentCommunity (ttcportals) site behind Cloudflare bot protection, which returns 403 to automated clients.
how_it_works: The ttcportals site lists jobs at /search/jobs with ?page=N (about 25 per page) and shows the total ('36' results). Job links match /jobs/\d+-slug. Scraping it would need access the Cloudflare challenge allows, such as an approved feed or allowlisting from the company. There is no public jobs.jobvite.com board to use instead.
evidence: curl to /search/jobs and /jobs.rss returns HTTP 403. browser_paginated also got HTTP 403. The evidence capture shows a Cloudflare challenge-platform request and webdriverDetected. jobs.jobvite.com/<slug> redirects to the 'invalid' page for every likely slug. gdlscanada.com/careers links only to the ttcportals site. The greenhouse 'general' board is unrelated.

summary: Bombardier uses SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting Marketing (new RMK jobs-search UI), which has a public JSON search API with a total, but no supported method covers it, and browser_paginated can't fit the results within max_browser_pages (20 pages of 10 jobs).
how_it_works: POST https://jobs.bombardier.com/services/recruiting/v1/jobs with JSON {"locale":"en_US","pageNumber":N,"sortBy":"","keywords":"","location":"Canada","facetFilters":{},"brand":"","skills":[],"categoryId":0,"alertId":"","rcmCandidateId":""}. The response has totalJobs and jobSearchResult[].response with id, unifiedStandardTitle, urlTitle, jobLocationShort, cust_employeeClass. Page size is fixed at 10, so increment pageNumber from 0 until jobSearchResult is missing or totalJobs is reached. Job URL: https://jobs.bombardier.com/job/{urlTitle}/{id}-en_US. Params would be site origin, location, keywords, and optional facetFilters such as {"jobLocationCountry":[...]}.
evidence: Tested on 2026-11-05: totalJobs is 916 overall, 655 with location=Canada, and 346 with keywords=intern + Canada (35 pages). keywords=intern matches prefixes such as internal/international, so it can't be narrowed further. The site's URL takes pageNumber and facetFilters (both echo into the page config), and browser_paginated with pageNumber did paginate, but failed with 'More result pages than max_browser_pages allows'. The cust_employeeClass=Temporary facet gets it down to 174 jobs but drops real interns that are classed as Regular (e.g. 'Intern, PMO Project Coordinator (Winter 2027)', 'Intern, Operations (Winter 2027)'). Other keywords (internship 67, stage 13, student 27) miss most intern titles.

summary: Add a Dayforce method. Christie's only job system is a Dayforce board (namespace cdsc, board CANDIDATEPORTAL), and its JSON API is behind Cloudflare.
how_it_works: In a real browser session, after the Cloudflare JS check passes, POST https://jobs.dayforcehcm.com/api/geo/{namespace}/jobposting/search with {clientNamespace, jobBoardCode, cultureCode:'en-US', distanceUnit:0, exactLocationOnly:false, paginationStart:N}, increasing paginationStart until all postings are read. Jobs link to /en-US/{namespace}/{board}/jobs/{id}. The method would take the namespace and board code as params, and it would read the total from the response.
evidence: evidence.json shows the page calling POST /api/geo/cdsc/jobposting/search (200 in the browser). A direct curl POST with the same body returns 403 from Cloudflare. christiedigital.com/about/careers redirects to Dayforce (globalus61.dayforcehcm.com/CandidatePortal/en-CAN/CDSC). browser_paginated and browser_page each found 8 jobs, but they could only reach needs_approval because the board shows no total.
